content: Good afternoon, this is the government service helpline. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I've been trying to check the status of my application, but I keep getting error messages online.
I understand how frustrating that can be. I reassure you that your application is safe in our system, and I'm here to help you get the information you need.
Thank you. I'm just worried it might have been lost or delayed.
Don't worry, your application is being processed as expected. You can trust me to guide you through the next steps and provide updates.
That's a relief. What should I do now to check the status properly?
I'll walk you through accessing the status directly, or I can provide the update for you right now. Either way, I'm here to make this easy.
